newsitem.title: UK: Tesco has no plan to market gas/electricity.
newsitem.headline: Tesco has no plan to market gas/electricity.

text.p: British supermarket group Tesco Plc said it had no current plans to enter the domestic electricity and gas markets when they open up for competition in 1998.
"There are no current plans to go into those markets," a spokeswoman said.
A report in the Independent newspaper said Tesco had in the past attended some meetings of independent suppliers organised by gas industry watchdog Ofgas.
The Independent said Tesco was no longer going to such meetings.
Tesco did not deny it had attended the meetings but the spokeswoman said the company "talks to a number of different companies at any one time on a range of subjects."
Gas and electricity markets for all consumers are scheduled to open up to competition in 1998.
